name: RAG Document QA Pipeline
description: Enterprise knowledge base retrieval-augmented generation pipeline injecting retrieved vector chunks into long system prompts.
architecturalAdvice: RAG architectures benefit tremendously from Prompt Caching. By pinning the shared system prompt and static chunk headers at the front of the context, 80%+ cache hit rates are achievable, cutting input token spend by up to 90%. Use hybrid routing: direct simple single-hop queries to efficient budget models while reserving reasoning models for synthesis.

name: Multi-Turn Customer Support Chatbot
description: High-volume customer service virtual assistant managing multi-turn troubleshooting conversations with session context persistence.
architecturalAdvice: Multi-turn chatbots suffer exponential context growth as prior turns compound into cumulative inputs. Implement sliding window truncation or summarization after 4 turns. Enable prompt caching on fixed system instructions and API schemas to safeguard margins during extended resolutions.

name: Automated PR & Code Review Agent
description: GitHub/GitLab bot analyzing code diffs, syntax trees, test suites, and style guidelines across incoming pull requests.
architecturalAdvice: PR review agents send large git diffs and codebase rules. Batch processing can be leveraged for non-blocking asynchronous CI/CD runs to claim a 50% discount. Cache repository guidelines and AST linter outputs across PR iterations.

name: Bulk PDF Invoice/Contract Extraction
description: High-throughput asynchronous invoice, receipt, and purchase order structured schema extraction and validation.
architecturalAdvice: Document extraction is ideal for Batch API queues (50% discount). Since output tokens represent structured JSON schemas and input tokens scale with PDF page count, pair vision-capable budget models (e.g., Gemini 2.5 Flash or GPT-4o mini) with strict Pydantic/Zod schemas to minimize regeneration loops.

name: Audio Transcript & Meeting Summarizer
description: Post-meeting action item and decision extractor processing 30-to-60 minute audio transcriptions into structured minutes.
architecturalAdvice: Transcripts typically range between 6,000 and 15,000 tokens. As a single-turn pipeline, input tokens dominate the bill. Utilize models with low input pricing and high context fidelity. Avoid multi-turn prompt loops by requesting both bulleted action items and full summaries in a single structured generation.

name: Enterprise Text-to-SQL Analytics Agent
description: Internal business intelligence copilot converting natural language business questions into optimized SQL queries against company schemas.
architecturalAdvice: Database schema definitions (DDLs), table comments, and business metric definitions rarely change throughout the day. By placing the complete database schema in the prompt prefix, you achieve 90%+ prompt cache reuse. Route simple lookup queries to small models and complex multi-table analytical joins to reasoning models.

name: Long-Context Legal Due Diligence
description: In-depth contract risk analysis, indemnity verification, and master services agreement audit across 100+ page contracts.
architecturalAdvice: Beware the Context-Cliff Surcharge! Prompts exceeding 128K or 200K tokens can trigger tiered 2x pricing on certain frontier providers. Structure document ingestion into chapterized clauses or ensure you are deploying models with predictable flat-rate long context windows like Gemini 2.5 Pro or Claude 3.5 Sonnet.

name: Batch Product Description Generator
description: Catalog ingestion pipeline synthesizing SEO meta descriptions, feature bullet points, and social ad copy for millions of SKUs.
architecturalAdvice: High-volume catalog enrichment is textbook Batch API territory: run jobs overnight with 24-hour SLA to cut operational costs by exactly 50%. Standardize brand tone and persona into cached system prefixes. Use budget tier models like DeepSeek-V3 or Gemini 2.5 Flash to achieve sub-$100 total monthly run rates for millions of items.
